"""One reviewed navigation-only deployment; immutable intent prevents replay."""
import datetime, hashlib, json, re, subprocess, sys, urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
if not __debug__: raise RuntimeError('Optimized execution refused')
commit=sys.argv[1]
assert re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}',commit)
read=lambda p:json.loads(Path(p).read_bytes())
git=lambda *args:subprocess.check_output(['git','-c','maintenance.auto=false','-c','gc.auto=0',*args])
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
now=lambda:datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
admission=read('.superpowers/m80-nav-deployment-admission.json')
assert admission['commit']==commit and admission['status']=='independently_reviewed_navigation_deployment'
assert admission['helper_sha256']==sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes())
qa=Path(admission['review']['path'])
assert sha(qa.read_bytes())==admission['review']['sha256']
assert read(qa)['verdict']=='pass_navigation_deployment_helper_only'
assert read(qa)['helper_sha256']==sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes())
assert git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()==commit
assert git('ls-remote','origin','refs/heads/codex/corporate-mvp').decode().split()[0]==commit
baseline='9dd9c85fb674528a2c1dd1b0138f5a2d87ba683e'
allowed={
 'apps/site-web/src/components/StagingWorkspace.tsx':'e0bdb05822d1a1eef379f9a2d54c7fd6f6cba969acd71306bdea3b49169f23a0',
 'apps/site-web/src/staging.css':'39b472061e8b8a0dcb47955aa3db8b6ff02861021cae9bc0f74b3db239e3df93',
 'packages/neuvetra-database/src/m80-contract.ts':'da21a85786c9d692619c6055860239bde9683e34e86dc1ce01b879619d0e4321',
 'packages/neuvetra-database/src/m80-fixture.ts':'a5510624d56542bddf563f4a723f9ce99f9d27793155e7456369460dc4f18b30',
 'packages/neuvetra-database/src/m80-validation.ts':'f2bb6546a71a8c52b0627f48809af2b76d21cb1b6085623fc0929123fe616919',
 'packages/neuvetra-database/src/m80-validation.test.ts':'d51a5af4641fa6443a7a20336d292d3013122bf7818a4f59e1433612ad1f45e5'}
changed=set(git('diff','--name-only',baseline,commit,'--','apps','packages').decode().splitlines())
assert changed and changed <= set(allowed)
for p in changed: assert sha(git('show',commit+':'+p))==allowed[p],p
# Changes beyond the already-reviewed PR6 navigation head must stay in this
# foundation/evidence batch. Earlier accepted offline M78 tools are not runtime.
reviewed_base='714e278cbfcc8bee4464a1c6fd108f8a09265146'
subprocess.run(['git','merge-base','--is-ancestor',reviewed_base,commit],check=True)
all_changes=set(git('diff','--name-only',reviewed_base,commit).decode().splitlines())
assert all(p in changed or p=='.gitattributes' or p.startswith(('docs/','operations/','evaluations/','claude-memory/')) for p in all_changes)
assert sha(git('show',commit+':.gitattributes'))=='e6cf76b3535acdd7e5a27e689ea18acc573965fb57e590214c7bb150e900911e'
ci=read('.superpowers/m80-current-checks.json')
required={'GHG calculation specifications and engine','Offline research catalog tests','Typecheck, lint, unit tests and web builds','Dedicated staging image and offline runtime smoke','Role routing and evidence records','Native PostgreSQL worksheet and tenant regression'}
def check_ci():
 assert ci['sha']==ci['pr_head']==commit and ci['state']=='open'
 assert 0 <= (now()-datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(ci['observed_at'])).total_seconds()<180
 assert {c['name'] for c in ci['checks']}==required
 assert len(ci['checks'])==6
 assert all(c['status']=='completed' and c['conclusion']=='success' for c in ci['checks'])
check_ci()
cli=['C:/Users/nimab/.bun/bin/bunx.exe','@railway/cli']
rows=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(cli+['deployment','list','--project','119f3652-9d84-4d16-983c-1a17c0fd1aaa','--service','f43abcf9-72f0-4034-828a-8d83ca26b0db','--environment','6642d65a-15a2-41e9-b25e-b7b01990aa28','--json'],timeout=55).decode('utf-8-sig'))
live=next(r for r in rows if r['id']=='f6d77b2e-6886-429b-a4d2-4873c9199ce8')
assert live['status']=='SUCCESS' and live['meta']['commitHash']==baseline
assert live['meta']['imageDigest']=='sha256:3e4c2c91591a5598a85f63b4099b1b4890588ce79ec832b21b7d284b5aa89d1b'
assert not any(r['id']!=live['id'] and r['status'] not in ('REMOVED','FAILED','CRASHED','SKIPPED') for r in rows)
auto=Path('.superpowers/m78-auto-status.graphql')
assert auto.read_text().strip()=='query { serviceInstanceAutoDeployStatus(environmentId:"6642d65a-15a2-41e9-b25e-b7b01990aa28",projectId:"119f3652-9d84-4d16-983c-1a17c0fd1aaa",serviceId:"f43abcf9-72f0-4034-828a-8d83ca26b0db") { enabled } }'
reply=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(cli+['api','--file',str(auto),'--compact'],timeout=55))
assert not reply.get('errors') and reply['data']['serviceInstanceAutoDeployStatus']['enabled'] is False
with urllib.request.urlopen('https://www.neuvetra.ai/ready',timeout=25) as response:
 assert response.status==200
 ready=json.load(response)
assert ready=={'status':'ready','profile':'neuvetra.private-synthetic-staging.v1','schemaVersion':21,'legacyContainmentVerified':True}
check_ci()
query='mutation { serviceInstanceDeployV2(environmentId:"6642d65a-15a2-41e9-b25e-b7b01990aa28",serviceId:"f43abcf9-72f0-4034-828a-8d83ca26b0db",commitSha:"'+commit+'") }'
query_path=Path('.superpowers/m80-nav-deploy.graphql')
with query_path.open('x',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n') as f:f.write(query+'\n')
with Path('.superpowers/m80-nav-deployment-intent.json').open('x',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n') as f:
 json.dump({'requested_at':now().isoformat(),'commit':commit,'prior_deployment':live['id'],'prior_image':live['meta']['imageDigest'],'schema_version':21,'no_migration':True,'admission_sha256':sha(Path('.superpowers/m80-nav-deployment-admission.json').read_bytes())},f,indent=2)
with Path('.superpowers/m80-nav-deployment-response.json').open('xb') as f:
 result=subprocess.run(cli+['api','--file',str(query_path),'--compact'],capture_output=True,timeout=55)
 f.write(result.stdout);f.flush()
 assert result.returncode==0,'Request uncertain; inspect receipt, never retry blindly'
 reply=json.loads(result.stdout)
 assert not reply.get('errors') and isinstance(reply['data']['serviceInstanceDeployV2'],str)
 print(json.dumps({'requested':True,'commit':commit,'deployment_id':reply['data']['serviceInstanceDeployV2']}))
